name: polystrata
note: Reference only; the source inputs are upstream project URLs, not AUR. Pinned to upstream tag v0.2.20-poly.6, one release past the AUR's 0.2.20-poly.5. polystrata.sh is the AUR launcher with one local change: an existing directory without the package's version stamp is now an error instead of running that directory's setup.sh. The AUR install script is dropped and its post-install notes live in README.md.
